findings.recommendation: Add table annotations for the unreferenced files or remove them from the dataset.

findings.title: Label and folder mismatches found

findings.recommendation: Audit and correct the conflicting labels in the table or the file paths.

findings.title: Data quality score improved

findings.title: Duplicate rows removed

findings.title: Missing values in notes column

findings.title: Confidence score distribution
findings.statement: Confidence scores are relatively stable with a mean of 86.16 and a median of 86.0, showing a slight negative skew of -0.3.

findings.title: Area pixel distribution
findings.statement: The area_px column has a mean of 4979.81 and a median of 4838.0, with a negative skew of -0.2.

findings.title: Small dataset size risk
findings.statement: The dataset is extremely small, containing only 37 rows, which poses a high risk of overfitting for an image classifier.

findings.title: Annotator imbalance
findings.statement: The 'annotator' column shows significant imbalance, with 'ana' having 16 entries while 'chen' has 6, which could introduce annotator bias.

findings.title: Small dataset size
findings.statement: The dataset contains only 38 images, which is a very small sample size for training a robust image classifier.

findings.title: High risk of overfitting
findings.statement: The dataset is extremely small with only 38 images total, which poses a high risk of overfitting regardless of data augmentation.

findings.title: Class imbalance present
findings.statement: The classes are imbalanced with 16 circles, 12 squares, and 10 triangles, resulting in an imbalance ratio of 1.6.

findings.title: High image quality
findings.statement: The dataset achieved a high quality score of 99.7 out of 100, with no corrupt, blurry, or duplicate images detected.

findings.title: Consistent image format
findings.statement: All 38 images are in JPEG format and RGB mode, ensuring consistency for the input layer of the model.

findings.title: AI-reviewed labels
findings.statement: An AI model review of the 38 images identified no suspected mislabels, though this observation does not constitute a ground-truth verification of the labels.

narrative.headline: High quality image formats but extreme risk of overfitting due to small sample size.
narrative.executive_summary: The shapes_survey dataset exhibits a high average data quality score of 92.4 out of 100 before cleaning and 95.6 after cleaning. However, it contains only 38 total files and 37 table rows, posing a severe risk of overfitting for an image classifier. Cleaning resolved issues like label and folder mismatches and removed 1 duplicate row, while images maintained consistent JPEG format and RGB mode. Class imbalance is present with 16 circles, 12 squares, and 10 triangles.
next_steps: Apply aggressive data augmentation to mitigate the extreme risk of overfitting from the 38 images.
Address the class imbalance across circles, squares, and triangles.
Resolve the 4 missing table descriptions and 3 label and folder mismatches.
Account for annotator bias stemming from the imbalance between 'ana' with 16 entries and 'chen' with 6 entries.
Handle the 43.24% missing values in the notes column before utilizing it for training.
